entry.title: [UPDATED] MAL-2026-17660: Malicious code in hardhat-option (npm)
entry.content:
Malicious code in hardhat-option (npm)

Affected:

  • hardhat-option

hardhat-option@2.0.1 was published to npm on 2026-10-07 09:12 UTC and removed by npm on 2026-10-07 15:29 UTC. Like hardhat-promised@2.21.0 (published the day before), the name targets the Ethereum development tool hardhat, and the package is a copy of the pino logger (README badges still point to pino) with one file added that pino does not contain: lib/config.js, a 4,499,968-byte obfuscated script. index.js requires ./lib/config on line 6, so the payload runs as soon as the package is required. package.json carries the same fake author as hardhat-promised (Robert King <hello@jsonspack.com>), no repository, and the added dependency axios. Behavior observed when lib/config.js is loaded in an instrumented sandbox: axios.post of JSON to http://167.88.172.33:8087/api/log containing os.hostnam…
